items.title: Returns to Buying Winners and Selling Losers
items.one_liner: Stocks that beat the market over the past year kept beating it over the following months. The result held for decades, then stopped paying the way it used to.
items.quotable: Sorting stocks on their prior year of returns earned 1.63 percent a month over the sample in the original paper, and 0.16 percent a month since 2009.
